# Agent layer tools

The event log and hosted tools that external agent processes (such as the Python agent layer) use.

6 tools in the `agent` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`events_poll`](#events_poll) | Read the engine's live event stream (the same events the editor's Activity feed shows: tool calls with their actor, studio changes such as messages, tasks, feedback, decisions and loops, play state, selection, scene loads/saves, asset changes) after a cursor, without consuming them. |
| [`tool_host_register`](#tool_host_register) | Offer tools implemented in your own process (a Python agent harness, a script) to every agent connected to this engine: each becomes an engine tool named py_&lt;name&gt; that appears in tools/list. |
| [`tool_host_poll`](#tool_host_poll) | Fetch the calls other agents made to your py_* tools (see tool_host_register): [{call, tool, args, actor}]. |
| [`tool_host_reply`](#tool_host_reply) | Answer one call fetched with tool_host_poll. |
| [`tool_host_unregister`](#tool_host_unregister) | Stop serving the py_* tools of a host (they disappear from tools/list; calls still waiting fail). |
| [`tool_host_list`](#tool_host_list) | Which external processes serve py_* tools: each host's label, owner (actor), tools, queued and in-flight calls, calls served and seconds since its last poll; plus the event stream's cursor range (events_poll). |

### `events_poll` { #events_poll }

**Follow engine events** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Read the engine's live event stream (the same events the editor's Activity feed shows: tool calls with their actor, studio changes such as messages, tasks, feedback, decisions and loops, play state, selection, scene loads/saves, asset changes) after a cursor, without consuming them. Pass the returned `next` as `since` on the next call; since=0 starts with everything still retained (the last 4096 events). Filter with types ("tool", "studio", "studio.message", "play_state", ...), actors (prefix match, e.g. "mcp:sky-agents") or exclude_actors. wait_ms > 0 long-polls until a matching event arrives (agent socket connections only; use a dedicated connection, the wait blocks that connection). Example: {since: 120, types: ["studio.message"], wait_ms: 20000}.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `since` | integer |  | Cursor: the `next` of the previous call (0 = from the oldest retained event) |  |
| `types` | string[] |  | Only these event types ("type" or "type.kind", e.g. "studio.task") |  |
| `actors` | string[] |  | Only events whose actor starts with one of these |  |
| `exclude_actors` | string[] |  | Skip events whose actor starts with one of these (e.g. your own) |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max events returned (default 200, max 1000) |  |
| `wait_ms` | integer |  | Long-poll: wait up to this long for a matching event (max 25000, default 0) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    events_poll {"since": 0, "types": ["studio.message", "studio.task"]}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call events_poll '{"since": 0, "types": ["studio.message", "studio.task"]}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "events_poll",
        "arguments": {
          "since": 0,
          "types": [
            "studio.message",
            "studio.task"
          ]
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `tool_host_register` { #tool_host_register }

**Serve tools from your process** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Offer tools implemented in your own process (a Python agent harness, a script) to every agent connected to this engine: each becomes an engine tool named py_<name> that appears in tools/list. Calls are queued for you; fetch them with tool_host_poll on a dedicated connection and answer each with tool_host_reply. Keep polling: a host that has not polled for ttl_seconds (default 60) is dropped with its tools. Re-register with the returned host id to change the tool set. Example: {label: "sky-agents memory", tools: [{name: "memory_recall", description: "Search the team's shared memory", input_schema: {type: "object", properties: {query: {type: "string"}}, required: ["query"]}}]}.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tools` | object[] | yes | The tools to serve |  |
| `tools[].name` | string | yes | Tool name (py_ is prepended) |  |
| `tools[].title` | string |  | Short title |  |
| `tools[].description` | string |  | What it does, for language models |  |
| `tools[].input_schema` | object |  | JSON Schema of the arguments |  |
| `tools[].mutates` | boolean |  | Changes the project or game (default false) |  |
| `host` | string |  | Your host id from an earlier registration (to update its tool set) |  |
| `label` | string |  | Who serves these tools, shown in descriptions and tool_host_list |  |
| `ttl_seconds` | number |  | Drop this host after this long without a poll (30-3600, default 60) |  |
| `replace` | boolean |  | Take over names another host serves (default false) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    tool_host_register {"tools": [{"name": "memory_recall", "description": "Search shared memory"}]}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call tool_host_register '{"tools": [{"name": "memory_recall", "description": "Search shared memory"}]}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "tool_host_register",
        "arguments": {
          "tools": [
            {
              "name": "memory_recall",
              "description": "Search shared memory"
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `tool_host_poll` { #tool_host_poll }

**Fetch calls for your tools** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Fetch the calls other agents made to your py_* tools (see tool_host_register): [{call, tool, args, actor}]. wait_ms long-polls until a call arrives (default 20000, max 25000); use a connection dedicated to polling. Answer every call with tool_host_reply. Polling also keeps your host alive.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | yes | Your host id |  |
| `wait_ms` | integer |  | Wait up to this long for a call (default 20000, max 25000) |  |
| `max` | integer |  | Max calls returned (default 8, max 64) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    tool_host_poll {"host": "host"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call tool_host_poll '{"host": "host"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "tool_host_poll",
        "arguments": {
          "host": "host"
        }
      }
    }
    ```

<small>Minimal call with the required arguments; see the table for everything else.</small>

### `tool_host_reply` { #tool_host_reply }

**Answer a tool call** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Answer one call fetched with tool_host_poll. Give text (what the calling model reads), optionally structured JSON and PNG images (base64), and is_error=true when the call failed (say why in text, with a hint).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | yes | Your host id |  |
| `call` | integer | yes | The call id from tool_host_poll |  |
| `text` | string |  | The result as text |  |
| `structured` | object |  | Machine-readable result |  |
| `images` | string[] |  | PNG images, base64 |  |
| `is_error` | boolean |  | The call failed |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    tool_host_reply {"host": "host", "call": 1}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call tool_host_reply '{"host": "host", "call": 1}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "tool_host_reply",
        "arguments": {
          "host": "host",
          "call": 1
        }
      }
    }
    ```

<small>Minimal call with the required arguments; see the table for everything else.</small>

### `tool_host_unregister` { #tool_host_unregister }

**Stop serving tools** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Stop serving the py_* tools of a host (they disappear from tools/list; calls still waiting fail). Hosts that stop polling expire on their own after ttl_seconds.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | yes | Host id |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    tool_host_unregister {"host": "host"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call tool_host_unregister '{"host": "host"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "tool_host_unregister",
        "arguments": {
          "host": "host"
        }
      }
    }
    ```

<small>Minimal call with the required arguments; see the table for everything else.</small>

### `tool_host_list` { #tool_host_list }

**Tool hosts** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Which external processes serve py_* tools: each host's label, owner (actor), tools, queued and in-flight calls, calls served and seconds since its last poll; plus the event stream's cursor range (events_poll).

Takes no arguments.

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    tool_host_list {}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call tool_host_list '{}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "tool_host_list",
        "arguments": {}
      }
    }
    ```
